weeks.content:
Sleeping lines, standing lines
Slanting lines left to right

Draw big and small circles
Trace half circles

Trace zigzag and wave patterns
Colour my pattern

Trace number 1 and 2
Write on my own

Trace number 3 and 4
Write neatly in the lines

Trace number 5
Count five and write five

Trace the letters of the week
Say each sound

Trace the letters of the week
Write on my own

Trace my name
Write the first letter of my name

Write our best letters
Show neat writing on the wall
